note: CopyCheck v2 per-model tuning. Keys match LM Studio model keys. ctx = contextLength, gpu = offloadRatio (passed as --gpu to lms load), max_par = numParallelSessions loaded on the server. Client-side concurrency is a per-cell ladder derived from max_par so the shared KV pool is never oversubscribed: L=1, M=max_par/2, S=max_par. That keeps every cell's aggregate demand (peak ~6.7k tokens/req for L) inside the 16k pool; slot count is free VRAM-wise because the KV pool is unified and sized by ctx, not by slots. The harness auto-halves max_par for a model if a stream ever ends without finish_reason. repeats = baseline repetitions per cell: 100 for the four small/fast models, 20 for mid, 10 for the three heaviest. Execution order is heavy-first (sorted on size_bytes descending).
